note: Paper money only. Claude's daily review may tune these numbers. Demo copies go to demo.kalshi.co only.

data_pot.note: Separate fake $1,000 pot: about $2 on one pseudo-random outcome of every Kalshi game starting in the next 6 hours, all sports. For data (calibration, fees, line movement), never copied to the demo.

other_markets.note: Separate fake $1,000 pot for Kalshi weather (7 cities), crypto (BTC/ETH hourly) and economics (CPI, jobs, Fed). $2 data bets on one random live outcome per event, plus the weather-forecast strategy vs the National Weather Service forecast. Never copied to the demo.

backtest.note: Stock strategy backtests on ~20 years of Yahoo prices, rerun weekly into state/backtest.json.
